data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for sending mobile applications to background.
data.what_it_does: Provides a method to programmatically send the application to the background on Android and iOS. It can be used alongside WillPopScope to prevent exiting the app when the back button is pressed.
use_when: You want to send the application to the background instead of closing it when the back button is pressed.
avoid_when: Building for iOS if you want to strictly adhere to Apple's Human Interface Guidelines regarding background behavior.
You need complex navigation or lifecycle management.
weaknesses: Programmatically sending an app to the background on iOS violates Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, which may cause app store review issues.
Limited to a single specific function.
